verdict.rationale: Treg brokers provider credentials and runs hosted OAuth connection flows, so white-labeling that flow is a fair question. The evidence documents only treg-operated flows: a team's own provider API key is injected server-side when present, and catalog entries note access to your own accounts via official OAuth. Nothing documents a white-labeled authorization screen, custom branding, or configuring your own OAuth client ID/secret for the hosted flows; self-hostability alone does not evidence a white-label capability in the product. Missing for 10: documented branded/white-label consent flow, documented bring-your-own OAuth app client credentials, hands-on corroboration.
